Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] commanded an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship'''. It was involved in the [[Battle of Florrum]].
